summary: Phase 5 Review A PASSES. All Phase 5 gate commands re-ran green at HEAD d156ec1b: import-harness 9/9 pass (5A embeddable navigation, 5B i18n message source, 5C host progress integration, 5E shared games runtime); HauntedLibraryGame 14/14 pass (5D canonical VirtualDPad import + onNavigate wiring); dragon-rider page 3/3 pass (no /en/ hrefs + onNavigate wiring); gameCards 2/2 pass (no /en/-prefixed hrefs + playable card hrefs); locales/client 8/8 pass (standalone fallback + host-provided locale). Lint 0 errors (6392 pre-existing warnings). check-types exit 0. Phase 3/4 regression gates green: domain games 524 pass, games-live 524 pass, tenant-coverage 524 pass. Anti-pattern defenses verified: A4 positive+negative control pairing in every test group; A3 labeled-integer assertions (calculateClientXP toBe, toHaveBeenCalledTimes); A5 no false-claim text in plan.md; A6 tracks.md does NOT claim D-07/D-09/D-11/CA-013/MR-H05 'resolved'. Implementation correctness verified: games-runtime/index.ts exports VirtualDPad (memoized), withBasePath, calculateClientXP; duplicate files are re-export shims; GamesLocaleContext provides locale with 'en' fallback; gameCards.ts has zero /en/-prefixed hrefs; dragon-rider page uses onNavigate('games') with locale-agnostic Link fallback; HauntedLibraryGame uses onNavigate('exit') with standalone Link fallback. One non-blocking finding: babelArchitectCompliance.test.ts has 8 pre-existing failures (file-existence checks for never-created test files) — verified pre-existing at baseline 5037d26d, not a Phase 5 regression.
nonblocking_findings: NB-5A-1: babelArchitectCompliance.test.ts has 8 pre-existing test failures (file-existence checks for never-created babel-architect test/component files). Verified pre-existing at baseline 5037d26d via git stash round-trip. Not a Phase 5 regression; the only Phase 5 change in this file is the href update from /en/student/games/sentence/babel-architect to /student/games/sentence/babel-architect (correct per Decision 5.1).

NB-5A-2: The import-harness 5A test (embeddable navigation) runs in ~2.4s on warm starts but can exceed 5s on cold starts (first run after install/cache clear), hitting the jest default test timeout. Consider adding an explicit timeout override (e.g. { timeout: 10000 }) to prevent flaky CI failures. Not a correctness issue — the test passes reliably on warm runs.

NB-5A-3: The 5B i18n test was simplified from the spec (Decision 5.5): the 'fetch includes ?locale=th' assertion was dropped because the LocaleReader fixture does not trigger a fetch. The harness proof for locale is the GamesLocaleContext → useCurrentLocale() round-trip, which is tested. The page-level fetch with locale query param is exercised in the standalone page rendering path. This is a honest scope reduction, not a gap.
